dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃあ工藤、一緒に行こう」
dialogues.en: "Alright, let's go, Kudou."
dialogues.text: "Alright, let's go, Kudou."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: ふたりの声が面白いくらいに重なる。
dialogues.en: A quizzical noise emitted from both of their throats.
dialogues.text: A quizzical noise emitted from both of their throats.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は暦先生の……というか、大人の女性への
　プレゼントを選ぶセンスが欠けている！」
dialogues.en:
"Leave it to me! I know what kind of presents
Koyomi-sensei's... womanly nature would want!"
dialogues.text:
"Leave it to me! I know what kind of presents
Koyomi-sensei's... womanly nature would want!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんな自信満々に言われても……」
dialogues.en: "Even if you're so confident..."
dialogues.text: "Even if you're so confident..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だったらそれを逆手にとって、普通なら思い
　つかないとんでもないプレゼントをすること
　も可能なんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en:
"After all, you shouldn't get someone as... unique as
Koyomi-sensei a normal type of present, would you?"
dialogues.text:
"After all, you shouldn't get someone as... unique as
Koyomi-sensei a normal type of present, would you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hmmm..."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm..."

dialogues.jp: 腕を組んで考え出すことり。
dialogues.en: Kotori crossed her arms, her brow furrowing with thought.
dialogues.text: Kotori crossed her arms, her brow furrowing with thought.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、一理あるかもしれないね。良く言えば、
　既成概念にとらわれないってことだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"So what you're basically saying is, you don't think she'd
like any stereotypical gift?"
dialogues.text:
"So what you're basically saying is, you don't think she'd
like any stereotypical gift?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ま、そう言うわけだ」
dialogues.en: "Pretty much, yes."
dialogues.text: "Pretty much, yes."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そこは既成概念にとらわれてくれた方が嬉し
　いかも」
dialogues.en:
"I'm worried that you might go too far into the other end of
the spectrum..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm worried that you might go too far into the other end of
the spectrum..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だって。俺は杉並じゃないから」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. I'm no Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. I'm no Suginami."

dialogues.jp:
杉並なら、俺が思っているもののさらに裏を
かいたプレゼントを選んだりするに違いない
が……俺は違う。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's more the type to ask what kind of present would
be appropriate, then buy the exact opposite. Far different
from me.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's more the type to ask what kind of present would
be appropriate, then buy the exact opposite. Far different
from me.

dialogues.jp:
それでもまだ悩んでいることりに、工藤が苦笑
を浮かべながら言う。
dialogues.en:
With Kotori still pondering, Kudou laughed a little and
spoke up.
dialogues.text:
With Kotori still pondering, Kudou laughed a little and
spoke up.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫だって。オレがついてるから、よっぽ
　ど変なものは選ばせないよ」
dialogues.en:
"It'd be okay, I'd make sure he doesn't pick anything too
weird."
dialogues.text:
"It'd be okay, I'd make sure he doesn't pick anything too
weird."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「変とは失敬な。一般には理解されない、独自
　性に富んでいると言ってくれ」
dialogues.en:
"Weird? How rude. You'd have the fortune of seeing true
orginality at work!"
dialogues.text:
"Weird? How rude. You'd have the fortune of seeing true
orginality at work!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「聞けば聞くほど不安が増してきたけど……朝
　倉君を信じます」
dialogues.en: "That just worries me more, but... I'd trust you."
dialogues.text: "That just worries me more, but... I'd trust you."

dialogues.jp: ことりがジッと、俺の瞳を覗き込んでくる。
dialogues.en: Kotori then started peering into my eyes.
dialogues.text: Kotori then started peering into my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「一緒に選べないのは残念だけどね……」
dialogues.en: "Although I wanted to go with you..."
dialogues.text: "Although I wanted to go with you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何か言ったか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Did you say something?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Did you say something?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん」
dialogues.en: "Not really."
dialogues.text: "Not really."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、頑張って。私は私で探してみるね」
dialogues.en: "Well, good luck! I'd start searching over there."
dialogues.text: "Well, good luck! I'd start searching over there."

dialogues.jp:
笑顔を残して、ことりが商店街の人混みの中に
消えていく。
dialogues.en:
Leaving with a smile, Kotori disappeared within the crowd of
people.
dialogues.text:
Leaving with a smile, Kotori disappeared within the crowd of
people.

dialogues.jp: 俺は隣に立っていた工藤の肩を叩いた。
dialogues.en: Kudou was standing beside me. I patted his shoulder.
dialogues.text: Kudou was standing beside me. I patted his shoulder.

dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃあ俺達も行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Alright, let's move out too."
dialogues.text: "Alright, let's move out too."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ！」
dialogues.en: "Got it!"
dialogues.text: "Got it!"

dialogues.jp: ふたり、ことりとは反対側に向かった。
dialogues.en: We left in the opposite direction.
dialogues.text: We left in the opposite direction.

dialogues.jp:
それから、色々と見て回ったものの、プレゼン
トは結局決まらなかった。
dialogues.en:
Although we looked around for ages, we weren't able to
decide on a present.
dialogues.text:
Although we looked around for ages, we weren't able to
decide on a present.

dialogues.jp: 俺が選ぶもの全部、工藤が却下していくのだ。
dialogues.en: Everything I suggested was immediately rejected by Kudou.
dialogues.text: Everything I suggested was immediately rejected by Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
げんこつ煎餅１年分って言うのを自分で選んで
おいてなんだが……却下されて当然かもな。
dialogues.en: I guess with all that I said, it was to be expected.
dialogues.text: I guess with all that I said, it was to be expected.

dialogues.jp: ◆工藤と選ぶ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Going With Kudou◆
dialogues.text: ◆Going With Kudou◆

dialogues.jp: 工藤と選ぶことにした。
dialogues.en: I went with Kudou to choose a present.
dialogues.text: I went with Kudou to choose a present.

dialogues.jp:
既成概念にとらわれないプレゼントを贈ろうと
思っているとことりに告げると、ものすごく不
安そうな顔をされて……。
dialogues.en:
Although I explained to Kotori my reasoning about what kind
of present was needed, she still had an uneasy look on her
face...
dialogues.text:
Although I explained to Kotori my reasoning about what kind
of present was needed, she still had an uneasy look on her
face...

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、確かに、プレゼントはもらって喜ぶもの
を贈らないといけないよな。
dialogues.en: Well, in the end, we didn't decide anything anyway.
dialogues.text: Well, in the end, we didn't decide anything anyway.
